note: The President's address plays as a montage (owner, Oct 29 02:35: the cutaways alternate the President working with America; the Vice President, Congress and the player's governor appear named by office as the camera passes; it ends at home). One beat per part of the speech. `levels` keys each part's beat to its role (the first non-salutation level of its sentences, agreed with Words, Nov 2): the first part is always the President at the desk and the last is always home. Each kind names its tagged place picture; `america` lists the town's pictures in turn, the first that has one painted. The sequence of beats is the lane's framing, not a record. Only a place with a mannequin plate (art/people-rooms/mannequin-plates) draws people: the Oval Office address (the speaker at the desk), the Oval Office (officials seated and standing), the colonnade, the train depot platform (people along a route) and the home living room.
